messages.subject: need very basic advice
parts:
hello

I recently started reviewing the DISTANCE program, I have no experience
whatsoever with any kind of program for calculating population densities =
or
abundances, and would like to know if you could help me decide on which
program will suit my needs. I am currently carrying out a study on a smal=
l
wetlands area in the New Mexico desert, focusing on all bird taxa and the=

use they give to each habitat type. One of the goals of the study is to
obtain densities and abundance of the present species. I have set 43 poin=
t
counts, where I am recording the distance of each detection. The study ar=
ea
is relatively small, and I don't think I will have the minimum number of
records for almost any species for the DISTANCE program to calculate
densities. I read in the help files that there is a possibility of using
surrogate data for the species with a small number of records. My questio=
n
would be concerning this issue. Is this alternative reliable, or
recommendable? And if not, would another computer program be more conveni=
ent
for my purposes?

I appreciate your time and attention

sincerely

James Barr
